page.notes: The right-hand fragment "tiendum dibofitum fit" is uncertain; the last number may be 545 or 546. The numbers after "Æternitas absoluta" and the "tám" at the top are doubtful readings. Several letters in the index are printed in a worn or broken face. The top of this part is cut off, so the first entry starts mid-entry; no running head or page number is visible. Long s is written as plain s. Entry text is italic in the scan; the page numbers and Roman numerals are roman. Two words are slightly doubtful in the scan: "semperne" and "Angeli" are copied as printed.
